spec.title: Astronaut places seed film into Veggie plant pillows aboard ISS
spec.summary: A crew member wearing blue gloves takes a small seed film packet, moves it over the plant pillow tray, and inserts it into one of the pillows, repeating the process for multiple pillows.
warnings: Object poses estimated without calibrated scale reference; coordinates are approximate based on visual layout.
Only one seed film packet is explicitly tracked; repeated placements may use separate packets not individually visible.
open_questions: How many repetitions of insert/release occur in the full clip?
